text: {"reply":"I'm sorry, this is frightening. Please stay away from traffic. Keep your hazard lights on, and if you can do so safely, wait outside the car and away from the road. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911. Please don't drive the car. A person will take over this chat now for the tow and your complaint. I can't see account details yet. Your message has two different plates, so a person will confirm who the account holder is. Can you tell me the highway and the nearest exit or cross street, so the team knows where you are?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports the vehicle shut off while driving on a highway and is stopped on the shoulder. They need urgent roadside help. They also mention a diagnostic fee from an earlier visit, say a previous ticket was ignored, and say they will contact CAMVAP, which is a formal complaint. They gave one plate, then said it was a mix-up with a spouse's car, but the plate they repeated is the same one. The records may conflict, so nothing was verified or shared. Please confirm the account holder and authorisation, find the location, and arrange the tow.","policy_rules_cited":["P07","P14","P02","P12","P15"]}
